title: KATSEYE adds Day 2 to Manila stop of 'Wildworld' in Jan 2027

blocks.text: Global girl group KATSEYE has officially added a second show to the Manila leg of their “THE WILDWORLD TOUR” in January 2027, following overwhelming demand from Filipino fans. Concert promoter Live Nation Philippines announced the additional date on social media, giving local supporters—known as EYEKONS—another chance to catch the six-member act live. The announcement comes shortly after tickets for the initial show quickly sold out during pre-sale and general on-sale periods.
